panels.description: Standard OpenFeature OpenTelemetry metrics hook (go-sdk-contrib hooks/open-telemetry in the agent; lib/openfeature_otel_hooks.py with the same names in the Python services): feature_flag_evaluation_requests_total, one per evaluation that reached a provider, by feature_flag_key. Python services evaluate in process; the agent evaluates over flagd's RPC port.
panels.title: Evaluations / s (by flag, top 15)

panels.description: Standard OpenFeature OpenTelemetry metrics hook (go-sdk-contrib hooks/open-telemetry in the agent; lib/openfeature_otel_hooks.py with the same names in the Python services): feature_flag_evaluation_success_total by feature_flag_key and feature_flag_result_variant. A variant the flag service generated for a written value shows as scoped_value (game / experiment scoped) or overlay_value (stack overlay), so the label stays bounded; the real variant name is on the feature_flag.evaluation span event.
panels.title: Evaluations / s (by flag and variant, top 15)

panels.description: Standard OpenFeature OpenTelemetry metrics hook (go-sdk-contrib hooks/open-telemetry in the agent; lib/openfeature_otel_hooks.py with the same names in the Python services): feature_flag_evaluation_success_total by the OpenFeature reason: STATIC (the default variant), TARGETING_MATCH (a targeting rule chose it, e.g. a game-scoped intervention), DEFAULT, SPLIT, CACHED (agent RPC cache), ERROR.
panels.title: Evaluations / s (by reason)

panels.description: Standard OpenFeature OpenTelemetry metrics hook (go-sdk-contrib hooks/open-telemetry in the agent; lib/openfeature_otel_hooks.py with the same names in the Python services): feature_flag_evaluation_requests_total by job (service).
panels.title: Evaluations / s (by service)

panels.description: Standard OpenFeature OpenTelemetry metrics hook (go-sdk-contrib hooks/open-telemetry in the agent; lib/openfeature_otel_hooks.py with the same names in the Python services): feature_flag_evaluation_success_total over the dashboard time range.
panels.title: Evaluations by flag, variant and reason (time range)

panels.description: Standard OpenFeature OpenTelemetry metrics hook (go-sdk-contrib hooks/open-telemetry in the agent; lib/openfeature_otel_hooks.py with the same names in the Python services): feature_flag_evaluation_error_total by feature_flag_key: evaluations whose provider returned an error (flag not found, type mismatch, provider not ready). The hook's free-text error.message is not a label.
panels.title: Evaluation errors / min (by flag, OpenFeature)

panels.description: flag_eval_errors_total{flag_key, reason} (lib/flag_eval_visibility.py, #921): Python getter reads that returned their hardcoded default, by OpenFeature error code (TYPE_MISMATCH, FLAG_NOT_FOUND, ...) or exception class. Kept next to the standard counter because it carries the reason, counts exceptions raised outside the SDK, and suppresses the provider-not-ready startup race.

targets.expr: sum by (flag_key, reason) (rate(flag_eval_errors_total[5m])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "flag_key", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Fallbacks to the default / min (by flag and reason)

panels.description: feature_flag_evaluation_error_total / (feature_flag_evaluation_success_total + feature_flag_evaluation_error_total) over 5 minutes, all services. Not over requests_total: an evaluation on a NOT_READY or FATAL provider runs the error hook without the before hook, so it is an error that was never counted as a request.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(feature_flag_evaluation_error_total[5m])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(feature_flag_evaluation_success_total[5m])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(feature_flag_evaluation_error_total[5m])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

panels.title: Error share (5m)

panels.description: sum of flag_eval_errors_total over the last hour.
panels.title: Fallbacks (1h)

panels.description: flagservice_writes_total by flag_set, result (ok, rejected, error) and op (set, append, clear, dry_run): every write to the in-memory flag service (agent interventions, menu admin, stage scripts; UC-053 BR-005).
panels.title: Writes / min (by flag set, result and op)

panels.description: flagservice_writes_total{result!="ok"} by flag_set and reason (out_of_bounds, game_not_live, flag_read_only, no_sync_stream, ...).

targets.expr: sum by (flag_set, reason) (rate(flagservice_writes_total{result!="ok"}[5m])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "reason", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Rejected and failed writes / min (by flag set and reason)
